verdict.rationale: Governance and funding transparency is a fair question for an open-source game engine, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only covers licensing (MIT/Apache 2.0, no fees) and release notes. Nothing in it mentions a foundation, published finances, a governance structure, or a public roadmap. Licensing openness and good release notes are adjacent topics and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a studio lead, the project's governance and funding are transparent — a foundation, published finances, or a public roadmap I can plan against
